body.zh-Hant: 尼洛·佩薩尼亞於1867年10月2日生於當時里約熱內盧省的坎普斯，1887年自累西腓法學院畢業。他早年投入廢奴與共和運動，並在坎普斯參與共和黨的成立工作。
body.en: Nilo Peçanha was born on 2 October 1867 in Campos, then in the province of Rio de Janeiro, and took his law degree at the Recife Law Faculty in 1887. He entered politics through the abolitionist and republican movements and helped found the Republican Party in Campos.

Data de Nascimento: 02/10/1867

heading.zh-Hant: 制憲會議與聯邦眾議員

body.zh-Hant: 1890年他以共和黨名單當選制憲代表，並參與1891年2月24日公布的憲法；其後連任聯邦眾議員，1899年12月又當選1900至1902年任期的議員。1899年7月23日，由他與阿爾貝托·托雷斯的結盟成立了里約熱內盧共和黨。
body.en: In 1890 he was elected on the Republican Party ticket to the Constituent Assembly, took part in drafting the constitution promulgated on 24 February 1891, and was re-elected federal deputy for later legislatures; in December 1899 he was elected again for 1900-1902. On 23 July 1899 the Republican Party of Rio de Janeiro was founded out of his alliance with Alberto Torres.

body.zh-Hant: 1903年12月31日他就任里約熱內盧州州長；1906年2月26日他參與簽署塔烏巴特協定，確立咖啡價格支持政策的共同基礎。1906年3月他與阿豐索·佩納搭檔當選副總統，11月1日把州政府交給奧利韋拉·博泰略，並於11月15日就任副總統。
body.en: He took office as president (governor) of Rio de Janeiro state on 31 December 1903 and was one of the parties to the Taubaté Convention signed on 26 February 1906, which set the common basis for coffee valorisation. Elected with Afonso Pena in March 1906, he handed the state government to Oliveira Botelho on 1 November and took office as vice-president on 15 November.

body.zh-Hant: 1909年6月阿豐索·佩納去世，他接任總統，任期約17個月，到1910年11月。任內設立農工商部，並創辦工藝學徒學校，1909年還決定提前償付外債。1910年11月15日他把總統職位交給埃爾梅斯·達·豐塞卡。
body.en: When Afonso Pena died in June 1909 he assumed the presidency, which he held for 17 months until November 1910. He created the Ministry of Agriculture, Industry and Commerce and founded the Schools of Apprentice Craftsmen, and in 1909 ordered early repayment of the external debt. He handed the presidency to Hermes da Fonseca on 15 November 1910.

heading.zh-Hant: 參議員、外交部長與反對派候選人
heading.en: Senator, foreign minister and opposition candidate

body.zh-Hant: 1912年他當選里約熱內盧州聯邦參議員；1914年12月31日就任州長，但1917年5月7日辭職，改任外交部長，任內巴西於1917年10月26日對德宣戰，1918年11月15日卸任。1921年他以共和反動運動候選人參選總統，敗給阿圖爾·貝爾納德斯，1924年3月31日逝世。
body.en: In 1912 he was elected senator for Rio de Janeiro. He took office again as state president on 31 December 1914 but resigned on 7 May 1917 to become foreign minister; Brazil declared war on Germany on 26 October 1917, and he left the ministry on 15 November 1918. In 1921 he ran for president for the Reação Republicana and lost to Arthur Bernardes; he died on 31 March 1924.

people.name: Pedro José Rada y Gamio
people.nameZh: 佩德羅·何塞·拉達-伊-加米奧

body.zh-Hant: 佩德羅·何塞·拉達-伊-加米奧生於1873年的阿雷基帕，1938年在利馬去世。他1893年取得文學學士，工作上兼顧律師業務與母校文學教席，並於1897至1903年擔任阿雷基帕的候補眾議員。
body.en: Pedro José Rada y Gamio was born in Arequipa in 1873 and died in Lima in 1938. He took a bachelor's degree in letters in 1893, combined legal practice with a chair of literature at his alma mater, and served as an alternate deputy for Arequipa in 1897-1903.

citations.quote: Arequipa, 1873-Lima, 1938.
En 1893 se graduó de bachiller en Letras
Alternó el ejercicio forense con la cátedra de Literatura en su alma máter.
Fue diputado suplente por Arequipa (1897-1903).

heading.zh-Hant: 外交起步、議會與地方職務

body.zh-Hant: 他以駐教廷公使館秘書（1911年）進入外交界，1919年代表阿雷基帕出席國民大會，1921至1922年擔任眾議院議長，1922年出任利馬市長。他被描述為萊吉亞政權的積極合作者，曾任公共工程部長；1925年部會新大樓啟用時，他以該部部長身分致詞。
body.en: He began his diplomatic career as secretary of the Peruvian legation at the Holy See in 1911, represented Arequipa in the National Assembly in 1919, presided over the Chamber of Deputies in 1921-1922 and was mayor of Lima in 1922. Described as an active collaborator of the Leguía regime, he served as minister of Development and Public Works and, as minister, gave the speech when the ministry's new building opened in 1925.

heading.en: Foreign minister and head of cabinet

body.zh-Hant: 1926年12月7日，時任外交部長的拉達被任命為內閣首長；總理府出版品稱，他在任內以外交部長兼內閣總理身分簽署1929年條約，結果塔克納回歸秘魯、阿里卡歸智利。1929年總統咨文也記載，他以外交部長身分率領國家代表團前往塔克納接收該省。
body.en: On 7 December 1926 Rada, then foreign minister, was designated head of cabinet. The Council of Ministers' own history says that during his term the 1929 Treaty was concluded, which he signed as foreign minister and president of the Council of Ministers; Tacna returned to Peru and Arica was lost. The 1929 presidential message adds that he headed the national delegation to Tacna to receive the province.

待查證：缺起日；總理府小傳寫「Fue ministro de Fomento y Obras Públicas」，無年份；MTC 官網只證明1925年他以該部部長身分致詞，而總理府又寫他至1924年為內政部長，兩者先後次序未能釐清；起訖日皆缺，未寫入。
待查證：缺迄日；總理府小傳寫1911年任駐教廷公使館秘書並署理館務（encargado de negocios），無迄日；已查總理府、國會、MTC 頁，未見其他出處。
待查證：缺起日；小傳只寫1929年當選阿雷基帕參議員，任期至1930年政變止，未見就任日；已查總理府、國會咨文。

people.name: Juan Isidro Jiménez
people.nameZh: 胡安·伊西德羅·希門內斯

body.zh-Hant: 1912年塔夫脫政府介入多明尼加內戰之後，大主教阿道夫·諾埃爾出任總統，並在1913年3月下旬辭職；1913年12月，美國又主導了制憲議會選舉。
body.en: After the Taft administration intervened in the Dominican civil war in 1912, Archbishop Adolfo A. Nouel became president and resigned in late March 1913; in December 1913 the United States supervised elections for a constituent assembly.

citations.quote: intervened in a civil war in the Dominican Republic in 1912
Archbishop Adolfo A. Nouel became president
he resigned in late March 1913
supervised elections in December 1913 for a constituent assembly

body.zh-Hant: 1914年底，多明尼加人依美國的選舉方案舉行總統選舉，候選人是胡安·伊西德羅·希門內斯與奧拉西奧·巴斯克斯，兩人分別代表國內兩大派系。希門內斯勝選，並在1914年12月5日就任。
body.en: Following a U.S. electoral plan, the Dominicans held a presidential election in late 1914. The candidates, Juan Isidro Jiménez and Horacio Vásquez, represented the two strongest political factions in the country. Jiménez won and took office on 5 December 1914.

citations.quote: the Dominicans held a presidential election in late 1914
The candidates, Juan Isidro Jiménez and Horacio Vásquez
represented the two strongest political factions in the country
Jiménez won and took office on 5 December 1914

body.zh-Hant: 美國在他就任後立刻要求更大的財政控制與干預特權，希門內斯加以抵制，卻無法克服對手的持續反對。德西德里奧·阿里亞斯原是希門內斯所領導自由派游擊運動的重要將領，在希門內斯當選後被任命為戰爭與海軍部長。
body.en: The United States immediately pressed for more financial control and intervention privileges. Jiménez resisted these demands but could not overcome the continued opposition of his rivals. Desiderio Arias had emerged as a key leader in the Liberal guerrilla movement led by Jiménez and was assigned the post of minister of war and the navy after his election.

citations.quote: the United States immediately pressed for more financial control
Arias emerged as a key leader
pressed for more financial control and intervention privileges
Jiménez resisted these demands
he could not overcome the continued opposition of his rivals
Liberal guerrilla movement led by Juan I. Jiménez in the 1910s
Assigned to the post of minister of war and the navy after Jiménez's election

body.zh-Hant: 1916年5月，希門內斯解除阿里亞斯的戰爭部長職務；阿里亞斯的部隊占領聖多明各市、希門內斯辭職之後，美國出面干預：卡珀頓海軍上將要求阿里亞斯撤出並占領該市，威爾遜隨後在1916年11月26日宣布全面軍事佔領。
body.en: Jiménez dismissed Arias as minister of war in May 1916. After Arias's forces took the city of Santo Domingo and Jiménez resigned, the United States intervened: Admiral William B. Caperton demanded that Arias withdraw and occupied the city, and President Wilson proclaimed full military occupation of the Dominican Republic on 26 November 1916.

After Arias's forces took the city of Santo Domingo and Jiménez resigned
Admiral William B. Caperton demanded that Arias withdraw and occupied the city
full military occupation of the Dominican Republic on 26 November 1916
